messages:
rita: FYI I found wrapped vault responses in stdout logs from auth-proxy in staging. They contain the KMS key version id and the base64 ciphertext blobs. No plaintext secrets, but key metadata + ciphertexts leaked.

dave: ok treat as sensitive. even ciphertext+key version info can help an attacker if wrapping key compromised. Which services wrote the logs?

rita: auth-proxy and an ad-hoc migration job (mig-runner-23). Logs show lines like `wrap_kms_version=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/km | ciphertext=CiQ...`

irene: this is a vault->kms wrap debug leak. immediate mitigations: 1) rotate KMS key version and create a new primary; 2) rotate Vault's wrapping key config to use the new version; 3) block any logs that contain `ciphertext=` from being indexed; 4) create detection for KMS key-version exposure.

rita: agreed. I'll patch logging sidecar to redact fields named `ciphertext`, `wrap_kms_version`. Prep rollout to staging.

dave: i'll coordinate KMS rotation. plan: create new key version v3, set as primary, update IAM on the new version to lock down access, then initiate rewrap for secrets that were recently accessed by auth-proxy. question : rewrap all secrets now or stagger?

irene: stagger. rewrap production-critical secrets immediately (db creds, api tokens), schedule lower-tier rewrap over 48h. Also emit an audit event in Vault on rewrap so we can track.

rita: quick scan across 72h found ~12 distinct ciphertext blobs emitted across staging. none appear in prod logs yet. posting list to incident ticket.

ops-bot: Ansible job started by rita: logging-redact/ciphertext-rule -> staging

dave: adding IAM lock: removing broad `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` from service account `auth-proxy-svc` and granting limited access via cloudkms:decrypt on new key version only.

irene: when rotating Vault wrapping key, ensure you also rotate transit key versions in Vault and update `transform-wrapping` policy. Also check if any wrap/unwrap operations were logged to external sinks (ELK, stackdriver).

rita: redact rule pushed: `if field in ["ciphertext","wrap_kms_version"] then redact`  deployed to staging sidecars. monitoring for hits.

dave: new KMS version created: projects/.../cryptoKeys/km/cryptoKeyVersions/3. Updated primary. Starting targeted rewrap for services tagged critical. I'll annotate incident ticket with rewrap progress.

rita: detection rule: add metric for occurrence of `ciphertext=` pattern and alert at >1 event per hour in prod. regex used: `ciphertext=[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{40,}`

irene: good. also add a CI lint to block commits that add `wrap_kms_version` or `ciphertext` into logging calls. failing fast is important. I'll file the rule.

ops-bot: Deploy started by dave: kms-rotate-v3 -> prod (canary)

rita: one nuance: some older wrapped blobs reference v1 which is scheduled for destruction in 6 months. rewrapping everything immediately could cause CPU spikes. propose rewrap window and throttling.

dave: agree throttle to 20 rps rewrap and prioritize secrets which had access in last 30d. scheduling rewrap job with queue.

irene: for forensic scope: run access logs for cloudkms.decrypt and vault transit/unwrap for past 90 days and look for anomalous IPs or service accounts. Also run entitlement review to see who can call decrypt on the old key versions.

rita: staging redaction alert fired 3 times (mig-runner-23). I quarantined the job and pushed a patched image that removes debug wrap logging.

dave: rotated auth-proxy SA IAM bindings and revoked old tokens. note: one long-running batch consumer needed a deploy restart to pick up new key; restarted now.

ops-bot: Deploy finished: logging-redact/ciphertext-rule -> staging (success)

irene: assign owners: rita = log redaction + vuln scan of jobs, dave = KMS rotation + rewrap orchestration, irene = audit + CI lint + forensic run. Anyone to run secret re-encryption tool?

dave: I'll run the rewrap orchestration. using `gcloud kms restore` and Vault `transit:rewrap` job via batch with concurrency limits. Posting job plan.

rita: small follow-up: add a honeypot wrapped secret (dummy ciphertext) in staging that alerts if unwrapped outside expected service. could help detect attempts to misuse leaked ciphertexts.

irene: nice idea. implement and add to monitoring.

dave: rewrap job started for priority secrets. ETA ~45m due to throttling.

rita: filing PR to remove wrap debug logging in auth-proxy and migration jobs. also adding sanitizer util to shared lib: `sanitizeWrapMetadata()` which strips `wrap_kms_version` and ciphertext before logging.

ops-bot: Job started by dave: kms-rewrap-priority -> background (pid=4421)

irene: after wrap rotation and rewrap, schedule an RCA and update the security baseline to include: redact-by-default for any field matching `ciphertext|wrap_*|secret_*`, require CI lint for logging changes, and periodic checks for KMS metadata in logs.

dave: rewrap progress: 8/12 priority secrets done. no failures so far.

rita: thanks. will continue log sweep for any other exposures. closing the immediate containment loop once rewrap completes and CI lint landed. :white_check_mark:
